visualReview.notes: All14 current portable views actually inspected in six combined contact sheets. Final geometry ends dormitory tiled roofs before paired turret terminal blocks; real turret window cavities and long crocketed spires retained. Church lower campanile windows are distinct rounded/pointed openings. Nine local photographs individually inspected,37 contact thumbnails, two previously inspected official heritage aerials and six printed pages of the official2025 museum programme. Retains the full integral long dormitory facade, eleven normal bays each side of the three-bay central pavilion, four distinct end turrets in front/rear pairs, broad ribbed church dome, separate west entrance and projecting tiered south portal. The chamfered two-storey cloister has24 broad bays with three lower shafts and paired upper lights, real open gallery depth, medallion parapets and conical pinnacles. Large west court, separate lower south chapel, attached north rooms and church/chancel roof masses follow native plan and photographs. Fine statuary, faces, inscriptions, foliage and armorial carving are generalized. No photograph pixels used as model textures.
